pcs.pc_description: introduce the historical roots of bangle making in India, highlighting its centuries-old tradition and its role as a symbol of cultural identity and craftsmanship

in Indian society, bangles symbolize marital status, prosperity, and well-being. Married women often wear them as a sign of their union, while single women and girls also adorn them for cultural and aesthetic reasons
bangles have evolved from being solely traditional accessories to fashion statements, with contemporary designs catering to modern tastes
discuss how bangle making is practiced across different regions of India, each with its own distinct style, materials, and techniques.
traditional materials for making bangles include glass, metal, lac, and wood, showcasing the diversity of resources and skills across different regions.
bangle making involves skilled artisans shaping and crafting each bangle individually using traditional tools and techniques.

modules.module_title: perform bangle making process as per the standard procedures

pcs.pc_description: remove the front area of the shell from the conch and separate the inner area of the shell and make a hole.
prepare a solution of water with some citric acid
clean the shell and dip it in prepared water solution for a couple of days to attain a soft texture to work on
dry the shells in hot sun and separate a perfect set of conch ,then broke it into two pieces from the middle.
broken piece came out in round shape, make it perfect using a grinding machine
polish the upper layer of the shell and cut it into several pieces, atleast in 2 to 5 bangles
engrave the designs and pattern on the plain white conch bangles using a chisel and designing machine
draw different motifs like flowers, leaves, animals, deities to historical images and embellish the bangle
polish the bangle by heating and applying nitric acid
repair any defective bangles by using lac, zinc oxide, coal, wax and wood

preheat the tank furnace at around 1300 °C to 1400 °C and heat the glass mixture for 15 hours until becomes molten.

modules.module_title: perform bangle making process as per the standard procedures

pcs.pc_description: carefully scoop out globs of molten glass using 8-9 feet long iron rod
beat and rotate the scooped out globs on a hot and flat surface
add colour on beaten glob
draw thin filament of glob on a coiling rod
loop molten glass around the rod to give the shape of bangle
cool the prepared glass spirals on a tray
separate the spiralled glass with the help of a diamond cutter
join the ends of prepared bangles by heating both the ends either by candle or on fire
decorate bangles with different types of decoration material like zari, polish, etc.

modules.module_title: collect tools and raw material for making metal bangle

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material such as raw wire (brass or any as per requirement), Sulphuric acid & nitric acid solution, etc.
place required material at workplace in a safe manner
collect tools such as marker, measuring scale, tapper (wooden hammer or light weight wooden tool), wire cutter, shaping rod, etc.
arrange machinery like shaping and alignment pressing machine, designing machine, and electric oven/furnace based on the properties of the raw metal used, etc.

modules.module_title: perform the standard process of making metal bangle

pcs.pc_description: mark the wire to be cut into the required size using a marker and cut the wire with the help of a cutter in a safe manner
bend the wire in round shape using shaping rod and tapper
join the ends of the round-shaped wire by soldering, and put the soldered bangle in a solution of nitric acid and sulphate to derust and clean the soldered round shaped bangle
provide the required shape to the cleaned bangle using a shaping & alignment pressing machine or manually by using hand tools
design the bangle using designing machines or manually create different designs using hand tools, etc. in a careful manner

prepare a solution of sulphuric acid and nitric acid (solution may differ for different types of metal bangle) and soak the designed bangle for approx. two to five seconds to make them lustrous and rust free
place the coated bangles in an electric oven or furnace as per the properties of metal to dry them
pack the bangle using paper and cardboard boxes, etc. safely and in a delicate manner.
